CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of General Epistle: James? (1 mark)
   A. Use General Epistle: James to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Epistle: James.
   D. Say General Epistle: James has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings? (1 mark)
   A. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Study Methods Devotional Method to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Bible Study Methods Devotional Method has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Study Methods Devotional Method.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Biblical Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Biblical Stewardship.
   C. Say Biblical Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Biblical Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o.
   B. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King David? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King David with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King David.
   C. Use Monarchy in Israel: King David to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Monarchy in Israel: King David has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah.
   B. Say Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Hosea.
   C. Use Prophet Hosea to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Schism and Syncretism in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Use Schism and Syncretism in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Schism and Syncretism in Israel has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Schism and Syncretism in Israel.
   D. Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Church-State Relationship Models of Church- State Relations: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Moral Issues Facing the Youth Today and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Challenges Facing Marriage and Family Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Law, Order and Justice and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
